verdicts.reason: A reads left to right with a dominant headline, can and a legible 'Grab a Can' CTA, but the 'New Flavour' circle is squashed into a pill, the 'Zero Sugar' card crowds the right end, and the FIZZBANG! logo is shrunk to an illegible sliver jammed against the right edge. B leaves the left third empty and makes the CTA, 'New Flavour' and 'Zero Sugar' tiny, unreadable fragments under the headline, so the CTA is buried. Its can floats isolated, and the FIZZBANG! logo is the largest item but is clipped at the right and bottom edges, which inverts the hierarchy.
